dvids.title: USS Boxer Holds 9/11 Remembrance Ceremony
dvids.desc: A U.S. Sailors and Marines assigned to Wasp-class amphibious assault ship USS Boxer (LHD 4) and 11th Marine Expeditionary Unit, recognized the 25th anniversary of the Sept. 11 attacks with a remembrance ceremony on the ship’s mess deck, Sept. 11, 2026.
